scenes.title: Santa Shishunala Sharifa
scenes.subtitle: Tatvapadagalu — The Philosophical Poems
scenes.narration: Santa Shishunala Sharifa, the mystic poet of Karnataka, wove profound philosophy into folk songs that still echo through the villages of the Deccan.

scenes.title: The Mystic Poet
scenes.subtitle: Born 1819 — Samadhi 1889
scenes.narration: Born in Shishuvinahala village in Haveri district, Sharifa was raised in a unique Hindu-Muslim household and became a bridge builder between faiths.

scenes.title: Life Journey
scenes.narration: His life spanned the 19th century, a time when the Bhakti tradition met rational thought, and he became its brightest voice.

scenes.title: The Village Saint
scenes.subtitle: Shishuvinahala, Haveri District
scenes.narration: Sharifa never left his village, yet his wisdom spread across linguistic and religious boundaries, sung by both Hindus and Muslims alike.

scenes.title: Legacy in Numbers
scenes.description: Blending Advaita Vedanta with Sufi mysticism in simple Kannada
scenes.narration: Over two hundred philosophical poems known as Tatvapadagalu, composed in the simple Kannada of everyday folk.

scenes.title: Famous Tatvapadagalu
items: Muddada Muttu — The Pearl of Love
Baaluva Aata — Life is a Game
scenes.narration: Each poem used folk metaphors to convey the deepest truths of Vedanta, wrapped in melodies that farmers and weavers could sing.

scenes.title: Where Sufi Meets Vedanta
scenes.subtitle: Philosophy of Oneness
scenes.narration: His core teaching was simple: God is one, all paths lead to the same truth. He rejected caste and dogma, calling love the only religion.

scenes.title: A Glimpse of His Wisdom
scenes.quote: Muddada muttannu nambade — olavannu nambi nodu. Banda nodu baa ninna — olavina belakinalli.
scenes.narration: Do not believe the pearl to be the true gem, he said. Seek love instead, and see the world in the light of that love.

scenes.title: Living Legacy
scenes.subtitle: Carried Forward by Folk Traditions
scenes.narration: His Tatvapadagalu are still sung by folk troupes across Karnataka, carrying the saint's message of unity across generations.

scenes.title: ತತ್ವಪದಗಳು
scenes.subtitle: Shishunala Sharifa — The Eternal Wisdom
scenes.narration: The poems of Shishunala Sharifa remind us that wisdom needs no temple, no mosque, only an open heart.
